project.projectDesc: Turns source data and spreadsheet-based scenario calculations into a repeatable Python and AWS workflow.

caseStudy.summary: This project replaces a manual spreadsheet-based financial modeling workflow with a repeatable Python and AWS data pipeline. I contributed data preparation, scenario-modeling automation, cloud workflow development, and training for portfolio managers.
caseStudy.challenge: Complex calculations and source data were handled through unstructured spreadsheets, making the workflow difficult to repeat and maintain. The replacement needed to ingest data from multiple sources, transform it consistently, and produce scenario-based growth model outputs.
caseStudy.architecture: Source data is collected and transformed by Python workflows, then processed through event-driven AWS services to generate modeling outputs. The resulting workflow separates data preparation, scenario calculations, and output delivery from manual spreadsheet steps.
caseStudy.diagram:
flowchart LR
  Sources[Data sources] --> Ingest[Ingestion and validation]
  Ingest --> Python[Python transformations]
  Python --> AWS[AWS event-driven workflow]
  AWS --> Scenarios[Scenario modeling]
  Scenarios --> Outputs[Growth model outputs]
  Outputs --> Users[Portfolio managers]
contributions: Converted spreadsheet calculations into maintainable Python data-processing logic using Pandas and NumPy.
Built data cleaning and transformation steps for information from multiple sources.
Contributed event-driven AWS workflows for scenario-based growth model outputs.
Taught Python and data science fundamentals to portfolio managers using the tools.
tradeoffs: Moving formulas into code improves repeatability and reviewability, while requiring users to maintain clear assumptions and input definitions.
Event-driven cloud services support automation, but add orchestration and operational concerns compared with a local spreadsheet.
Reliable automation depends on explicit input definitions, data validation, and scenario assumptions.

performance: The reported workflow shifted from a multi-hour manual process to a minutes-long Python workflow.
business: Automation reduced manual spreadsheet work and made scenario outputs repeatable.
quality: Centralized transformations make the workflow easier to reproduce than scattered spreadsheet formulas.
